findings: world.gold is a SINGLE GLOBAL purse, not per-player: commandBankGold sweeps the entire purse into the acting player's vault (bank.ts). With two agents, whoever banks first collects both agents' loot gold. Conservation holds (no duplication) but attribution is wrong for multi-agent. SIM-level economy gap — flagged, not drive-by fixed.
